archimate:CourseOfAction.name: 3. aligning with NHB
archimate:CourseOfAction.documentation:
Giving regional and national teams a shared, single way of working with the NHB, so people spend less time navigating organisational silos.​
Not a priority pre-Christmas as there is a significant dependency on the EMSA development work and NHB recruitment. Focus is mainly on agreeing an approach between the NHB and regions (rather than detailed technology requirements).​
Level 2 capabilities are: Strategic prioritisation and triage​ Pipeline development ​ Market-making ​ Service and product development ​ Operations oversight​ Fund management ​ Portfolio, programme and project management
